description: This file contains backend API implementations for cellular management, including creation, initialization, and removal of cellular data objects, with references to external APIs and internal data structures.

methods.name: CellularMgr_CellularCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cellular data object, returning its handle.

methods.name: CellularMgr_CellularInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the cellular data object, setting up internal data structures.

methods.name: CellularMgr_CellularRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees resources associated with the cellular data object.
